value.rationale: Gaussian stationary bias in random-midpoint Langevin integrators is a motivated numerical sampling question. This is the complete exact all-stage law and all-curvature feasibility classification for a published shared-Brownian explicit rule, with a practically interpretable covariance-vs-full-law warning and a sharp best exactly calibrated contraction. The statement does not claim general nonlinear-target or wall-time improvements, but it supplies a meaningful structural boundary and precise design law absent from the inspected baseline.
